is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.) and Anopheles arabiensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) on page 6 and page 8.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports the frequency of the L1014F allele of the kdr gene and the G119S allele of the ace-1R gene (page 8).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in southern Benin (Allada, Ifangni, Akpro-Missérété, and Porto-Novo).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting field collections and bioassays.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites at the commune and village level (e.g., Ita-Soumba in Ifangni, Akpro-Missérété, Gbodjè in Porto-Novo, and Allada).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from January to June 2022.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections conducted in 2022.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the susceptibility of wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. from four communes in southern Benin to new insecticides (chlorfenapyr, clothianidin, and pyriproxyfen) and evaluated the efficacy of new-generation ITNs (Interceptor G2 and Royal Guard). The study also performed molecular analysis for kdr L1014F and ace-1 G119S mutations.
